title: षोडशोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 16 · The churning of the ocean

summary.en: With Mount Mandara as the churning stick, the serpent Vasuki as the rope and the king of tortoises as its base, gods and demons churn the ocean. The moon, Shri, Sura, the white horse, the Kaustubha jewel and Dhanvantari with the elixir rise, and Narayana, taking the form of an enchanting woman, takes the elixir from the demons.
summary.kn: ಮಂದರಪರ್ವತವನ್ನು ಕಡಗೋಲಾಗಿ, ವಾಸುಕಿಯನ್ನು ಹಗ್ಗವಾಗಿ, ಕೂರ್ಮರಾಜನನ್ನು ಆಧಾರವಾಗಿ ಮಾಡಿ ದೇವದಾನವರು ಸಮುದ್ರ ಮಥಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಚಂದ್ರ, ಶ್ರೀ, ಸುರಾ, ಶ್ವೇತಾಶ್ವ, ಕೌಸ್ತುಭ ಮತ್ತು ಅಮೃತದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಧನ್ವಂತರಿ ಹೊರಬರುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಮೋಹಿನಿಯ ರೂಪ ಧರಿಸಿದ ನಾರಾಯಣನು ದಾನವರಿಂದ ಅಮೃತವನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: मन्दराचल को मथानी, वासुकि को रस्सी और कूर्मराज को आधार बनाकर देवता और दानव समुद्र मथते हैं। चन्द्रमा, श्री, सुरा, श्वेत अश्व, कौस्तुभ और अमृत लिए धन्वन्तरि निकलते हैं; मोहिनी रूप धरकर नारायण दानवों से अमृत ले लेते हैं।
summary.te: మందరపర్వతాన్ని కవ్వంగా, వాసుకిని తాడుగా, కూర్మరాజును ఆధారంగా చేసి దేవదానవులు సముద్రాన్ని మథిస్తారు. చంద్రుడు, శ్రీ, సుర, శ్వేతాశ్వం, కౌస్తుభం, అమృతంతో ధన్వంతరి ఉద్భవిస్తారు; మోహినీ రూపం ధరించిన నారాయణుడు దానవుల నుండి అమృతాన్ని తీసుకుంటాడు.
summary.ta: மந்தர மலையை மத்தாகவும், வாஸுகியைக் கயிறாகவும், ஆமை அரசனை அடித்தளமாகவும் கொண்டு தேவர்களும் அசுரர்களும் கடலைக் கடைகிறார்கள். சந்திரன், ஸ்ரீ, ஸுரா, வெண்குதிரை, கௌஸ்துபம், அமுதத்துடன் தன்வந்தரி தோன்றுகிறார்கள்; மோகினி வடிவெடுத்த நாராயணர் அசுரர்களிடமிருந்து அமுதத்தைப் பெறுகிறார்.
summary.ml: മന്ദരപർവതം കടകോലും, വാസുകി കയറും, ആമകളുടെ രാജാവ് അടിത്തറയുമായി ദേവന്മാരും അസുരന്മാരും സമുദ്രം കടയുന്നു. ചന്ദ്രൻ, ശ്രീ, സുര, വെള്ളക്കുതിര, കൗസ്തുഭരത്നം, അമൃതുമായി ധന്വന്തരി എന്നിവർ ഉയർന്നുവരുന്നു. മോഹിപ്പിക്കുന്ന സ്ത്രീരൂപമെടുത്ത നാരായണൻ അസുരന്മാരിൽ നിന്ന് അമൃത് കൈക്കലാക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 1.16; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Aug 22 2026

verses.text: सूत उवाच

meaning.en: Suta's son said:

verses.text:
ततोऽभ्रशिखराकारैर्गिरिशृङ्गैरलंकृतम् ।
मन्दरं पर्वतवरं लताजालसमावृतम् ॥

meaning.en: Then they turned to Mount Mandara, the best of mountains, adorned with peaks like cloud-crests and wrapped in a net of creepers.

verses.text:
नानाविहगसंघुष्टं नानादंष्ट्रिसमाकुलम् ।
किंनरैरप्सरोभिश्च देवैरपि च सेवितम् ॥

meaning.en: It rang with flocks of many birds, was thronged with beasts of many fangs, and was frequented by kinnaras, apsarases and even gods.

verses.text:
एकादश सहस्राणि योजनानां समुच्छ्रितम् ।
अधो भूमेः सहस्रेषु तावत्स्वेव प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥

meaning.en: It rose eleven thousand yojanas high, and was set as deep again, eleven thousand yojanas, below the earth.

verses.text:
तमुद्धर्तुं न शक्ता वै सर्वे देवगणास्तदा ।
विष्णुमासीनमभ्येत्य ब्रह्माणं चेदमब्रुवन् ॥

meaning.en: The assembled gods could not lift it. They went to Vishnu and Brahma, seated together, and said:

verses.text:
भवन्तावत्र कुरुतां बुद्धिं नैःश्रेयसीं पराम् ।
मन्दरोद्धरणे यत्नः क्रियतां च हिताय नः ॥

meaning.en: "Both of you, give your best thought to this, and make an effort to lift Mandara for our good."

verses.text:
तथेति चाब्रवीद्विष्णुर्ब्रह्मणा सह भार्गव ।
ततोऽनन्तः समुत्थाय ब्रह्मणा परिचोदितः ।
नारायणेन चाप्युक्तस्तस्मिन्कर्मणि वीर्यवान् ॥

meaning.en: Vishnu, with Brahma, agreed, descendant of Bhrigu. Then Ananta, the mighty one, rose, urged by Brahma and also told by Narayana to do the task.

verses.text:
अथ पर्वतराजानं तमनन्तो महाबलः ।
उज्जहार बलाद्ब्रह्मन्सवनं सवनौकसम् ॥

meaning.en: Brahmin, the very powerful Ananta then heaved up the king of mountains by force, together with its forests and forest dwellers.

verses.text:
ततस्तेन सुराः सार्धं समुद्रमुपतस्थिरे ।
तमूचुरमृतार्थाय निर्मथिष्यामहे जलम् ॥

meaning.en: With him the gods came to the ocean and told it, "We shall churn your waters for nectar."

verses.text:
अपांपतिरथोवाच ममाप्यंशो भवेत्ततः ।
सोढास्मि विपुलं मर्दं मन्दरभ्रमणादिति ॥

meaning.en: The lord of waters answered, "Let me too have a share. I shall endure the great crushing as Mandara spins."

verses.text:
ऊचुश्च कूर्मराजानमकूपारं सुरासुराः ।
गिरेरधिष्ठानमस्य भवान्भवितुमर्हति ॥

meaning.en: The gods and asuras then said to the king of tortoises, Akupara, "You are fit to be the base for this mountain."

verses.text:
कूर्मेण तु तथेत्युक्त्वा पृष्ठमस्य समर्पितम् ।
तस्य शैलस्य चाग्रं वै यन्त्रेणेन्द्रोऽभ्यपीडयत् ॥

meaning.en: The tortoise agreed and offered his back, and Indra pressed down the mountain's peak with a device.

verses.text:
मन्थानं मन्दरं कृत्वा तथा नेत्रं च वासुकिम् ।
देवा मथितुमारब्धाः समुद्रं निधिमम्भसाम् ।
अमृतार्थिनस्ततो ब्रह्मन्सहिता दैत्यदानवाः ॥

meaning.en: Making Mandara the churning rod and the serpent Vasuki the rope, the gods began to churn the ocean, the storehouse of waters, and, brahmin, the daityas and danavas joined them, wanting nectar.

verses.text:
एकमन्तमुपाश्लिष्टा नागराज्ञो महासुराः ।
विबुधाः सहिताः सर्वे यतः पुच्छं ततः स्थिताः ॥

meaning.en: The great asuras gathered at one end, at the serpent king's head, while all the gods stood together at the tail.

verses.text:
अनन्तो भगवान्देवो यतो नारायणस्ततः ।
शिर उद्यम्य नागस्य पुनः पुनरवाक्षिपत् ॥

meaning.en: Where Narayana was, there too was the divine Ananta; he lifted the serpent's head and shook it again and again.

verses.text:
वासुकेरथ नागस्य सहसाक्षिप्यतः सुरैः ।
सधूमाः सार्चिषो वाता निष्पेतुरसकृन्मुखात् ॥

meaning.en: As the gods repeatedly yanked the serpent Vasuki, hot winds with smoke and flames burst again and again from his mouths.

verses.text:
ते धूमसंघाः संभूता मेघसंघाः सविद्युतः ।
अभ्यवर्षन्सुरगणाञ्श्रमसंतापकर्शितान् ॥

meaning.en: Those masses of smoke became clouds with lightning and rained on the gods, who were worn out with the toil and heat.

verses.text:
तस्माच्च गिरिकूटाग्रात्प्रच्युताः पुष्पवृष्टयः ।
सुरासुरगणान्माल्यैः सर्वतः समवाकिरन् ॥

meaning.en: From the mountain's summit showers of flowers fell, and spread garlands all around over the gods and asuras.

verses.text:
बभूवात्र महाघोषो महामेघरवोपमः ।
उदधेर्मथ्यमानस्य मन्दरेण सुरासुरैः ॥

meaning.en: A great roar arose, like the thunder of great clouds, as gods and asuras churned the ocean with Mandara.

verses.text:
तत्र नानाजलचरा विनिष्पिष्टा महाद्रिणा ।
विलयं समुपाजग्मुः शतशो लवणाम्भसि ॥

meaning.en: The great mountain crushed many water creatures there, and they perished by the hundreds in the salt water.

verses.text:
वारुणानि च भूतानि विविधानि महीधरः ।
पातालतलवासीनि विलयं समुपानयत् ॥

meaning.en: It also destroyed the many beings of Varuna's realm that live in the depths below.

verses.text:
तस्मिंश्च भ्राम्यमाणेऽद्रौ संघृष्यन्तः परस्परम् ।
न्यपतन्पतगोपेताः पर्वताग्रान्महाद्रुमाः ॥

meaning.en: As the mountain spun, huge trees full of birds rubbed against each other and fell from its peaks.

verses.text:
तेषां संघर्षजश्चाग्निरर्चिर्भिः प्रज्वलन्मुहुः ।
विद्युद्भिरिव नीलाभ्रमावृणोन्मन्दरं गिरिम् ॥

meaning.en: The fire born from their friction blazed again and again with flames, and wrapped Mount Mandara as lightning wraps a dark blue cloud.

verses.text:
ददाह कुञ्जरांश्चैव सिंहांश्चैव विनिःसृतान् ।
विगतासूनि सर्वाणि सत्त्वानि विविधानि च ॥

meaning.en: It burned the elephants and lions that had fled out, and all the many kinds of creatures there lost their lives.

verses.text:
तमग्निममरश्रेष्ठः प्रदहन्तं ततस्ततः ।
वारिणा मेघजेनेन्द्रः शमयामास सर्वतः ॥

meaning.en: Indra, the best of the immortals, extinguished that fire raging everywhere with water from rain clouds.

verses.text:
ततो नानाविधास्तत्र सुस्रुवुः सागराम्भसि ।
महाद्रुमाणां निर्यासा बहवश्चौषधीरसाः ॥

meaning.en: Then the saps of great trees and many herbal juices flowed into the waters of the ocean.

verses.text:
तेषाममृतवीर्याणां रसानां पयसैव च ।
अमरत्वं सुरा जग्मुः काञ्चनस्य च निःस्रवात् ॥

meaning.en: Through those juices, which had the power of nectar, mixed with the milky water and the flow of gold, the gods gained immortality.

verses.text:
अथ तस्य समुद्रस्य तज्जातमुदकं पयः ।
रसोत्तमैर्विमिश्रं च ततः क्षीरादभूद्घृतम् ॥

meaning.en: The ocean's water, mixed with the finest juices, became milk, and from that milk came ghee.

verses.text:
ततो ब्रह्माणमासीनं देवा वरदमब्रुवन् ।
श्रान्ताः स्म सुभृशं ब्रह्मन्नोद्भवत्यमृतं च तत् ॥

meaning.en: Then the gods said to Brahma, the giver of boons, seated there, "We are utterly exhausted, Brahma, and yet the nectar does not appear.

verses.text:
ऋते नारायणं देवं दैत्या नागोत्तमास्तथा ।
चिरारब्धमिदं चापि सागरस्यापि मन्थनम् ॥

meaning.en: Except for the god Narayana, the daityas and the best of serpents are also weary. This churning of the ocean has gone on for a long time."

verses.text:
ततो नारायणं देवं ब्रह्मा वचनमब्रवीत् ।
विधत्स्वैषां बलं विष्णो भवानत्र परायणम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Brahma said to the god Narayana, "Vishnu, give them strength; you are their only refuge here."

verses.text: विष्णुरुवाच

meaning.en: Vishnu said:

verses.text:
बलं ददामि सर्वेषां कर्मैतद्ये समास्थिताः ।
क्षोभ्यतां कलशः सर्वैर्मन्दरः परिवर्त्यताम् ॥

meaning.en: I give strength to all who are engaged in this work. Let all stir the ocean and turn Mandara."

verses.text: सूत उवाच

meaning.en: Suta's son said:

verses.text:
नारायणवचः श्रुत्वा बलिनस्ते महोदधेः ।
तत्पयः सहिता भूयश्चक्रिरे भृशमाकुलम् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing Narayana's words, the mighty ones joined together and once more churned that water of the great ocean violently.

verses.text:
ततः शतसहस्रांशुः समान इव सागरात् ।
प्रसन्नभाः समुत्पन्नः सोमः शीतांशुरुज्ज्वलः ॥

meaning.en: Then from the ocean rose the bright and gentle moon, Soma, cool-rayed, shining like a hundred thousand rays.

verses.text:
श्रीरनन्तरमुत्पन्ना घृतात्पाण्डुरवासिनी ।
सुरा देवी समुत्पन्ना तुरगः पाण्डुरस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Next from the ghee came Shri, clothed in white, then the goddess Sura, and a white horse.

verses.text:
कौस्तुभश्च मणिर्दिव्य उत्पन्नोऽमृतसंभवः ।
मरीचिविकचः श्रीमान्नारायणउरोगतः ॥

meaning.en: The divine Kaustubha jewel, born of the nectar, also arose, radiant with brilliance, and came to rest on Narayana's chest.

verses.text:
श्रीः सुरा चैव सोमश्च तुरगश्च मनोजवः ।
यतो देवास्ततो जग्मुरादित्यपथमाश्रिताः ॥

meaning.en: Shri, Sura, Soma and the horse swift as thought went up toward the gods, following the path of the sun.

verses.text:
धन्वन्तरिस्ततो देवो वपुष्मानुदतिष्ठत ।
श्वेतं कमण्डलुं बिभ्रदमृतं यत्र तिष्ठति ॥

meaning.en: Then the god Dhanvantari arose in bodily form, carrying a white pot in which the nectar was held.

verses.text:
एतदत्यद्भुतं दृष्ट्वा दानवानां समुत्थितः ।
अमृतार्थे महान्नादो ममेदमिति जल्पताम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing this great wonder, a mighty uproar arose among the danavas, each shouting, "This is mine!" over the nectar.

verses.text:
ततो नारायणो मायामास्थितो मोहिनीं प्रभुः ।
स्त्रीरूपमद्भुतं कृत्वा दानवानभिसंश्रितः ॥

meaning.en: Then the lord Narayana took up his enchanting power of illusion, made a wondrous female form, and approached the danavas.

verses.text:
ततस्तदमृतं तस्यै ददुस्ते मूढचेतसः ।
स्त्रियै दानवदैतेयाः सर्वे तद्गतमानसाः ॥

meaning.en: Those deluded danavas and daityas, all minds fixed on her, handed that nectar over to the woman.
